capabilities: Open .vcf files in a dedicated read-only view
Parse one or more vCard blocks into contact cards
Search names, organizations, emails, phones and raw source
Show raw source with line numbers
Report import-preflight warnings for malformed or unsupported fields
disambiguation: Not a contact manager or CRM; it only displays .vcf files read-only and never creates contact notes.
extras: Privacy-focused: no network or clipboard APIs, no write-back to .vcf, no contact export or note creation, no click-to-call or mailto links, and PHOTO data is never loaded or rendered. BRAT can be used for beta testing.
intentEvidence: VCF Contacts Viewer is deliberately narrower: it is a file viewer and import-preflight tool
motivation: The author built it for safely reviewing vCards that arrive in a vault without turning Obsidian into a contact manager.
problem: vCards that arrive in a vault cannot be inspected safely inside Obsidian without a contact manager that may import, render or write contact data.

relations.evidence: The existing community plugin VCF Contacts is a richer contact manager with import, export, and markdown contact notes.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .vcf files as contact cards, with search, raw source with line numbers, and import-preflight warnings.
